notes: Fixes the black YouTube card introduced in the previous build. The loop asked the player to jump back to the start, but the player keeps reporting its old position for a moment afterwards - so the app thought it was still at the end and…
It now asks once and waits until the video has genuinely returned to the start before it will ask again, with a safety timer so a jump that never lands cannot stall the loop.
Verified on the real player: one jump per loop instead of a continuous stream of them, and the video carries on playing afterwards.
